@isTest private class CoreSystemRuntimeEvidenceCloseoutTest { @isTest static void stringContracts() { String text = 'Trail Mix Trail'; System.assertEquals('--go--', 'go'.center(6, '-')); System.assertEquals(3, 'trail'.indexOfDifference('track')); System.assertEquals(10, text.lastIndexOf('Trail', 12)); System.assertEquals(10, text.lastIndexOfChar(84)); System.assertEquals(0, text.lastIndexOfChar(84, 4)); System.assertEquals(10, text.lastIndexOfIgnoreCase('trail')); System.assertEquals(0, text.lastIndexOfIgnoreCase('trail', 4)); System.assertEquals('---go', 'go'.leftPad(5, '-')); System.assertEquals(15, text.length()); System.assertEquals(2, 'a😀b'.offsetByCodePoints(1, 1)); System.assertEquals('goxgo', 'go'.repeat('x', 2)); System.assertEquals('go---', 'go'.rightPad(5, '-')); System.assert(text.startsWith('Trail')); System.assertEquals('TrailMix', '

Trail
Mix

'.stripHtmlTags()); System.assertEquals('ail', 'trail'.substring(2)); System.assertEquals('ra', 'trail'.substring(1, 3)); System.assertEquals('middle', '[middle]'.substringBetween('[', ']')); System.assertEquals('trail', 'TRAIL'.toLowerCase()); System.assertEquals('trail', 'TRAIL'.toLowerCase('en_US')); System.assertEquals('TRAIL', 'trail'.toUpperCase()); System.assertEquals('TRAIL', 'trail'.toUpperCase('en_US')); System.assertEquals('nook', ' nook '.trim()); System.assertEquals('2024-02-29', String.valueOf(Date.newInstance(2024, 2, 29))); Datetime stamp = Datetime.valueOfGmt('2024-02-29 23:05:06'); System.assertEquals('2024-02-29 23:05:06', String.valueOfGmt(stamp)); System.assert(String.valueOf(stamp).contains('2024-02-29')); System.assertEquals('12.340', String.valueOf(Decimal.valueOf('12.340'))); System.assertEquals('2.5', String.valueOf(Double.valueOf('2.5'))); System.assertEquals('7', String.valueOf(7)); System.assertEquals('7000000000', String.valueOf(Long.valueOf('7000000000'))); System.assertEquals('false', String.valueOf((Object)false)); } @isTest static void userInfoContracts() { System.assert(UserInfo.getUserId().startsWith('005')); System.assert(UserInfo.getCurrentUvid().contains(':local')); System.assertEquals('USD', UserInfo.getDefaultCurrency()); System.assertEquals('System', UserInfo.getFirstName()); System.assertEquals('User', UserInfo.getLastName()); System.assertEquals('System User', UserInfo.getName()); System.assert(UserInfo.getOrganizationId().startsWith('00D')); System.assertEquals('GLADE Local Org', UserInfo.getOrganizationName()); System.assert(UserInfo.getProfileId().startsWith('00')); System.assertEquals('', UserInfo.getSessionId()); System.assertEquals('Theme4d', UserInfo.getUiTheme()); System.assertEquals('Theme4d', UserInfo.getUiThemeDisplayed()); System.assertEquals('system@example.invalid', UserInfo.getUserEmail()); System.assertEquals('system@example.invalid', UserInfo.getUserName()); System.assert(UserInfo.getUserRoleId().startsWith('00')); System.assertEquals('Standard', UserInfo.getUserType()); System.assertEquals(false, UserInfo.isCurrentUserLicensed('pkg')); System.assertEquals(false, UserInfo.isMultiCurrencyOrganization()); } @isTest static void sobjectAndTestContracts() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Trail'); System.assertEquals('Trail', account.get('Name')); System.assertEquals(false, account.isSet('AnnualRevenue')); System.assertEquals(null, account.put('AnnualRevenue', Decimal.valueOf('12.5'))); System.assertEquals(Decimal.valueOf('12.5'), account.get('AnnualRevenue')); System.assert(account.isSet('AnnualRevenue')); System.assertEquals('Trail', account.put('Name', 'Nook')); System.assertEquals('Nook', account.get('Name')); Map populated = account.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(); System.assert(populated.containsKey('Name')); Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); opts.AllowFieldTruncation = true; account.setOptions(opts); System.assertEquals(true, account.getOptions().AllowFieldTruncation); Account twoFlagClone = account.clone(false, true); Account threeFlagClone = account.clone(false, true, true); Account fourFlagClone = account.clone(false, true, true, true); System.assertEquals('Nook', twoFlagClone.Name); System.assertEquals('Nook', threeFlagClone.Name); System.assertEquals('Nook', fourFlagClone.Name); account.addError('row blocked'); account.addError('row blocked 2', false); account.addError('Name', 'name blocked'); account.addError('Name', 'name blocked 2', false); System.assert(account.hasErrors()); System.assert(account.getErrors().size() >= 4); User owner = new User(Id = UserInfo.getUserId(), LastName = 'Owner'); account.putSObject('Owner', owner); System.assertEquals('Owner', account.getSObject('Owner').get('LastName')); account.put('Contacts', new List{new Contact(LastName = 'Child')}); System.assertEquals(1, account.getSObjects('Contacts').size()); account.put('QuickActionName', 'Account.SendEmail'); System.assertEquals('Account.SendEmail', account.getQuickActionName()); account.recalculateFormulas(); account.clear(); System.assertEquals(false, account.isSet('Name')); System.assertEquals(0, Test.getFlexQueueOrder().size()); List batchIds = Test.enqueueBatchJobs(2); System.assertEquals(2, batchIds.size()); Test.calculatePermissionSetGroup('0PG000000000001'); Test.calculatePermissionSetGroup(new List{'0PG000000000001', '0PG000000000002'}); Test.setReadOnlyApplicationMode(true); Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'Created Date'); insert inserted; Datetime created = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2024, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5); Test.setCreatedDate(inserted.Id, created); Account queried = [SELECT CreatedDate FROM Account WHERE Id = :inserted.Id]; System.assertEquals(created, queried.CreatedDate); } }
